decision.observation: The 0.6s plain W failed: 0 mph, still gear R, red X back on. The car is pinned against the pine trunk at the lane's left edge again, with the tarmac to its screen-right curving up past puddles and barrels.
decision.hypothesis: Plain throttle re-pinned the car against the pine on its front-left; forward motion alone will not rotate it away. The reliable free is a 1s plain reverse, after which the forward hold must steer right rather than go straight.
decision.memory: From the lane just below this pine, plain W drifts the car left into the trunk. The pine sits at the lane's left edge; tarmac is right of it. Reversal frees; forward must be steered right.
